title: Mortgage Underwriting Document Automation

blueprintSignals.name: Net pay to statement credit match
blueprintSignals.definition: absolute difference between payslip net pay and matched salary credit within 3 days of pay date
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Matching window must use document dates, not upload dates

blueprintSignals.name: Document tamper score
blueprintSignals.definition: font, compression and metadata inconsistency score per page
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Scanner and phone-camera files must not be scored against born-digital files

blueprintSignals.name: Field confidence margin
blueprintSignals.definition: gap between top and second extraction hypothesis per field
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Margin must come from a calibrated model, not raw softmax

blueprintSignals.name: Pay frequency consistency
blueprintSignals.definition: implied annual income from payslip versus year-to-date figure
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Year-to-date fields are absent on some payslips

engineFeatures.meaning: capitalisation and digit pattern of a token
the words before and after, which carry the layout
where in the document the token sits

label: For "Mortgage Underwriting Document Automation": Classify, extract and cross-check the documents in a mortgage file (payslips, bank statements, tax returns, ID, valuation) so underwriters review exceptions instead of retyping fields. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Test files from the same broker as training inflate extraction accuracy.
